series.title: Moody / cinematic
series.about: Dark, warm 'desk-lamp at night' slides with short white lines. Post as a carousel with a calm instrumental track. The light is drawn in CSS; swap in real or stock desk photos later via the 'photo' field if wanted.

posts.caption:
Exam season doesn't need more hours. It needs fewer decisions. 🕯️

Save this for the night before.

slides.title:
You don't need
more hours.
slides.sub: You need *fewer topics at a time.* Pick the three that cost you the most marks. Start there.

slides.title:
Sleep is part
of the syllabus.
slides.sub: Your memory saves while you sleep. An all-nighter deletes the save file.

slides.title: Questions > notes.
slides.sub: Twenty minutes of past-paper questions beats two hours of rereading.

slides.title:
Mark it the
same night.
slides.sub: Feedback you get tomorrow is feedback you'll ignore.

slides.title: Calm isn't luck.
slides.sub:
*It's a plan you made last week.*
